_doc: Every way Guaardvark reaches outside this machine, in one list. The inbound guard reads it three ways: new code that names an outside host no entry declares is held at high severity (a declared host is still held, as any new destination is); the posture check reports any entry whose switch turns on; the network monitor extension reports a Guaardvark process reaching a host no entry declares. 'switch' says what turns a path on; 'person' means it runs only when someone starts it; 'connection' names a provider whose enabled connection with stored credentials turns it on while publishing is on. 'any_host' marks paths whose destination someone chooses (a URL, a configured server), which therefore declare no fixed host.

paths.title: Hugging Face: model installs a person starts with Install (image Studio and upscaling models among them), and Check access
paths.sends: model repository names; HF_TOKEN on downloads, never on Check access

paths.title: GitHub release weights and tools a person installs (CodeFormer, facexlib, rembg, whisper.cpp; Real-ESRGAN upscaling models and the GGUF converter for Export to Ollama, from Install only)
paths.sends: requests for the files being installed

paths.title: Installer and dependency reconcile (start.sh, plugin install)
paths.sends: package names and versions being installed

paths.title: Uncle Claude on a schedule: twice-daily advice, servo change reviews
paths.sends: time, node id, GPU name and memory (advice); a source excerpt and a proposed diff (servo review)

paths.title: Chat escalation mode 'always': every chat turn goes to Uncle Claude
paths.sends: each chat message and the last 10 turns of the conversation

paths.title: Uncle Claude when a person asks (Test connection, advice, a review they start)
Web access: search, page fetch, weather, YouTube outreach recon
paths.sends: search queries the model writes, so local text can be in them; fetches of public pages they name

paths.title: Code a chat model writes and runs (execute_python, execute_javascript)
paths.sends: whatever that code sends; off, it runs with no network or is not run

paths.title: Address suggestions (Geoapify)
paths.sends: typed address text (three characters or more) and the Geoapify key

paths.title: Social outreach (Reddit rules, threads, approved posts)
paths.sends: requests for rules and threads with the agent browser's Reddit cookies; approved posts

paths.title: Google Indexing auto-drip
paths.sends: up to 3 URLs from the site's sitemap every 15 minutes

paths.title: Interconnector client heartbeat and sync
paths.sends: hardware profile, hostname, node id, port, sync-entity list and the master API key, to the configured master

paths.title: Publish connections (YouTube, Bluesky, Mastodon, Telegram, Discord webhooks)
paths.sends: posts a person approves or publishes, at once or at the time scheduled for them, deletes a person asks for on Social Posts, and YouTube comments a person approves and starts with Post now, from an account they switched on for it

paths.title: LinkedIn connection: member posts through the official API, with the person's own LinkedIn app
paths.sends: the app's client id and secret and the authorization code (www.linkedin.com, when a person authorizes); the access token, a profile lookup on Test, and each post a person approves or its delete (api.linkedin.com)

paths.title: WordPress REST to a site a person configured
paths.sends: content the person pulls or pushes

paths.title: Crawl of a website a person added
paths.sends: requests for that site's pages and sitemaps

paths.title: Discord bot plugin
paths.sends: the bot's gateway session, messages it answers

paths.title: MCP servers a person configured (local commands; such a command may reach anywhere)
Ollama on another machine (OLLAMA_BASE_URL not on this one)
paths.sends: every chat prompt and model request
